photos.alt: A woman with trekking poles pauses on a sandy trail between granite boulders and pines, the snow-covered Continental Divide filling the distance.
Snow-streaked ridges of burned timber below Blodgett Peak, with the Pikes Peak massif under fresh snow across the valley.
A snowshoer in a yellow jacket climbs a wind-scoured snow slope through the bare standing trunks of a burned forest.
Alpine tundra on Mount Sniktau falls away toward Arapahoe Basin, with snow-filled couloirs on the ridges above Loveland Pass.
Manzanita and scrub oak cover a ridge below Bear Mountain, above red sandstone canyon walls near Sedona, Arizona.
Weathered sandstone cliffs and pillars on Bear Mountain rise above dense manzanita near Sedona, Arizona.
Saguaro cactus along a rocky ridge trail on Wasson Peak, with the Tucson basin and distant desert ranges beyond.
A waterfall drops over rock and fallen logs into thick green undergrowth below Fern Lake, Rocky Mountain National Park.
The granite dome of Greyrock Mountain, streaked with old snow and burned timber, above plains stretching north toward Wyoming.
A rock tower rises above a wildflower meadow and stream on the trail between Fern Lake and Odessa Lake, Rocky Mountain National Park.
A steep rock face and boulder field in morning light, with Longs Peak rising beyond the ridge.
Chimney Rock sandstone spires lit by low evening sun against a clear sky.
Palm trees on a green sea cliff above the surf at Pololu Valley, Hawaii.
Longs Peak silhouetted against a burning orange sunset sky.
Notchtop Mountain rising behind conifers in golden evening light.
Pololu Valley coastline with palms leaning out over the Pacific.
Orange and teal sunset banding above a dark Front Range ridgeline.
Layered mountain ridgelines fading into dusk from Trail Ridge Road.
